Company revenue grew to EUR 72.8 million from EUR 65.0 million, with net profit of EUR 11.6 million compared to EUR 10.7 million.

candidate_sentences.text: During the nine months ended 30 September 2025, AB KN Energies and its subsidiaries reported a consolidated net profit of 13,158 thousand euros, reflecting an increase compared to 11,862 thousand euros for the same period in 2024.
Consolidated revenue from contracts with customers grew to 76,664 thousand euros for the first nine months of 2025, up from 67,977 thousand euros during the corresponding period of 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operating profit increased to EUR 21.3 million (2025) from EUR 18.9 million (2024), driven by higher LNG regasification volumes, full terminal operational capacity (vs. 1.5 months downtime in 2024), and client capacity bonuses; partially offset by reduced LNG security supplement income due to regulatory excess return repayments.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income and Note 13 (page 13)

candidate_sentences.text: The group recorded a gross profit of 31,549 thousand euros, compared to 29,237 thousand euros previously, while operating profit increased to 21,282 thousand euros from 18,942 thousand euros.

The growth in revenue and profitability was primarily driven by higher income from liquefied natural gas terminal regasification services collected directly from users, which increased to 43,640 thousand euros from 31,401 thousand euros.

According to the report, this increase was influenced by the terminal not performing usual activities for one and a half months in 2024 due to dry-dock repair works, higher liquefied natural gas regasification volumes, and bonuses paid by clients for booked capacity.

Additionally, revenue from liquefied natural gas terminal services included in the security supplement decreased due to the reduction of income caused by the proportionally recognized repayment of excess returns from regulated activities during the 2022 to 2023 period.

verified_key_information_units.information: Segment performance: Liquid Energy Terminals (LET) revenue was EUR 21.9 million (2025 vs EUR 21.1 million), LNG Terminal (LNGT) revenue rose to EUR 45.6 million (vs EUR 38.4 million), and commercial LNG activities revenue increased to EUR 9.2 million (vs EUR 8.5 million).

candidate_sentences.text: The growth in revenue and profitability was primarily driven by higher income from liquefied natural gas terminal regasification services collected directly from users, which increased to 43,640 thousand euros from 31,401 thousand euros.

Sales of liquid energy products transshipment services also increased to 21,375 thousand euros from 20,241 thousand euros, and consulting services sales rose to 7,507 thousand euros from 3,961 thousand euros.

verified_key_information_units.information: Net cash generated from operating activities surged to EUR 76.3 million in 2025 from EUR 35.6 million in 2024, primarily due to higher net profit and net favorable working capital changes.

candidate_sentences.text: Net cash flows from operating activities improved significantly, reaching 76,331 thousand euros for the first nine months of 2025 compared to 35,637 thousand euros for the first nine months of 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: Group borrowings decreased slightly to EUR 294.4 million (2025) from EUR 301.4 million (2024), while lease liabilities remained stable at approximately EUR 24 million. Cash and cash equivalents increased significantly to EUR 54.4 million from EUR 17.2 million.

Establishment of KN Energies Deutschland GmbH in September 2024 to operate the Wilhelmshaven 2 floating LNG import terminal for Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH.

The summary covers most high-importance financial performance metrics but omits key balance sheet items and corporate actions, resulting in a 'Generally yes' score.

Explanations for revenue changes (S6-S10) are consistent with the reported figures. The summary maintains clear organizational flow from top-line revenue to bottom-line profit and cash flow metrics. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all numerical relationships (e.g., revenue growth driving profit increases) are logically consistent within the document itself. The summary forms a coherent whole with each section building upon prior information.
